## Summary

Describe the change, the problem solved, and why it is needed.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Fix
- [ ] Hardware / Wiring
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Performance / Power Safety

## Checklist

- [ ] Verified local compilation (`arduino-cli compile` or Arduino IDE).
- [ ] Kept the change focused within scope.
- [ ] Did not commit personal Wi-Fi credentials or secrets.
- [ ] Preserved power safety limits for the 5V power supply.
- [ ] Updated documentation if architecture or pinout changed.
- [ ] Included serial monitor or hardware test output.

## Hardware & Safety Impact

Does this change affect GPIO pin assignments, current/power consumption, or voltage levels?
If yes, explain the limits and verifications applied.

## Verification

Describe tests executed (compilation, hardware runs, serial telemetry, web UI tests).
